name: Dominion Energy North Carolina T-15 Reliability Project
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: roster has no T-15; P2567 MVP Southgate Expansion (Pittsylvania to Rockingham, 31.3 mi) is the upstream feed, a separate project. The consolidator's '37 mi existing line upgrade' is not supported: NC Newsline (Feb 2024) says Dominion plans to build a 45-mile pipeline between Eden and Roxboro that would parallel an existing pipeline right-of-way, so it is new pipe. An intrastate line, so no FERC filing; regulated by the NC Utilities Commission. Threshold: sponsor is Dominion Energy North Carolina (the PSNC gas utility, now Enbridge-owned per Appalachian Voices and SACE); endpoints Rockingham to Person County; concrete steps are a state 401 water quality certification approved 16 Sep 2025 and 2026 erosion and stormwater construction permits for laydown yards, a compressor station and a Duke metering station on the NC DEQ page. Length 45 mi is from NC Newsline and a union project page, which look to trace to one company announcement, so treat as one origin. Status construction is inferred from the 2026 land-disturbance permits and the 2025 to 2027 construction window in the SACE comments; no page seen confirms pipe in the ground, so check. In service target end of 2027 per search snippet of company page, not verified. Diameter, capacity and cost not found; SACE says large diameter, high pressure, confirmed diameter not disclosed. Route: no public GIS found. Owner spelled as the sources give it; entity_lookup found no exact gazetteer match for Dominion Energy North Carolina, so a person should pick the entity. Parent Enbridge Inc is an alias hit. Tier medium.
